comparison.objective: Set a one-handed diner's bowl and cup on a non-slip mat with the cup on the working side.
comparison.physical_skill: Table-setting transport and placement rather than bimanual counterholding and tool-mediated damper adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Correct mat membership and side placement versus repeatable safe carriage deceleration and retained adjustment. Placement tolerances are not given.
comparison.reason: The task tests accessibility-aware object arrangement, not mechanical tuning from observed dynamics.
